book.name: MATEUS
book.title: MATEUS Mateus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yesus nu nuŋe dubinaig taŋgo 12 wam pagu pasa niŋge deŋpurmba nu tiŋga ma ta tuku tumbraŋ afu mbol pasa kuklimba wam pagukam kina.
Yohanus nu taŋgo armba kukulnikina le Yesus tugum kinaik
Yohanus nu muli wandek sinamŋge minmba Kristus nu wam afu ke likina ta ismba nu tuku pasa pilna le nuŋe dubiwanu taŋgo armba ka Yesus kusnanaik:
Ande nu prowam tuku kuyar pasa sakate ta ne e ko sine ande tairŋgube ŋginaik le
nu pasa lafumba sanikina: Ye wam ke liket te takile ammbi kaŋgerka kilbambi isik ta luka kumba ŋakmba Yohanus kubeu tape.
Kile am tukulok mbal mambilde. Kupe ŋaigoŋgade mbal likade. Ŋgirŋger ŋak mageke likade. Kilba tukulok pasa isig. Afu kume likade ta aboŋga tiŋgade. Sanzal mbal Kuate tuku pasa mayenu isig.
Ande nu ye tuku ŋga wamdus tero ndakate ta nu gare-gareka minit. Tale taŋamba ka Yohanus sawap ŋgina.
Nale luka kinaik le Yesus nu ndek maŋgur suŋgo ta Yohanus tuku saniŋgina: Tane ame agaŋ kaŋgeram tuku ma baknu mbol kinaig? Bubreŋge ulem waŋe ande mbilmbilwa le tane kaŋgeram kinaig e?
Ko tane taŋgo ande tawi mayenu tiŋganu kaŋgeram kinaig e? Nane tawi magenu tiŋganu mbal wande sugo sinamŋge nyu ŋak minig tuku.
Tane ndaŋam tuku ma baknu mbol kinaig? Tane tuan taŋgo ande kaŋgeram kinaig e? Yohanus nu tuan taŋgo ta ye tane kila satiŋgamŋgit. Nu tuan taŋgo ndo kuga. Nu tuan taŋgo ŋakmba liniŋmba mbolŋge minit.
Kuyar pasa ande nu tuku teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Ne isa. Ye taŋgo ande kukuli le nu amboŋga prowa sulumba ne tuku ndin wakeiyamŋgat ŋgate. Malakai 3.1

content: Ye siŋka satiŋgamŋgit. Taŋgo ŋakmba Yohanus kule pisneŋge liniŋmba mbolŋge minit ta Kuate tuku gageu mayok kinig mbal ŋakmba nane Yohanus lide. Afu nyu kugatok mata.

Moses tuku tukul tuan taŋgo kame nane Kuate nu nuŋe gageu kulatkam tuku dir pasa ndo saka ka Yohanus mbolŋge dikŋginaig. Yohanus tuku ait mbolŋge tugu pilmba taŋgo pino gudommba Kuate tuku gageu mayok kambim tuku saŋgri tiŋga muŋgu signa-signaŋga mburerika kile minig.
Kuate nu nuŋe gageu kulatkate wam ta pro ndawa le Elia nu amboŋga prowam tuku kuyar pasa
sakate ta Yohanus tuku sakate. Tane pasa te ismba son ŋgade e?
Tane kilba ŋak ndeta pasa te isap.
Tane ait te mbolŋge minig mbal tane tuku maŋau ta ame wam taŋaŋ ŋga saki. Tane kiŋo kame maket mbolŋge minyoka muŋgu wiwikade taŋaŋ. Nane teŋenmba muŋgu wiwikade:
Sine tabu tabu fitka mune uleg ta tane ndek kupes kupes ndade. Sine maŋ malmbikeg ta tane ndek malmbiketket ŋga lok mine ndakade ŋgade.
Ata. Yohanus nu prona sulumba nyamagaŋ ko grep kule nye ndaka minna le nu bukla ŋayonu ŋak ŋga saka nu mbulnaig.

Ye Katesek Taŋgo ye pro nyamagaŋ le grep kule nyet le tane sakade: Ai si. Nu nyamagaŋ grep kule nyam tuku piririte taŋgo. Nu takis kilanu mbal une ŋak mbal ndoŋ gulab mayete ŋga tane ye mata mbulig. Ata. Wamdus kuyar mayete taŋgo wam ke likate ta mbolŋge nu tiŋreknu kilimok mayok kinit ŋga saniŋgina.
Tumbraŋ afu nane Yesus ŋgumnenaig
Tumbraŋ afu Yesus nu buk nane ŋgamukŋge wam kitek saŋgrinu ke likina ta nane ŋgamuŋgal biye mbil ndanaig tukunu kile nu nane kilmba saniŋge likina:

Korasin tumbraŋ le Betsaida tumbraŋ ose. Ye wam kitek saŋgrinu tale ŋgamukŋge ke liken ta ande nu wam ndui ta Tirus le Sidon ŋgamukŋge ke likina kande nane dal ndaka naŋgine mbar tuku ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba nane tawi urfunu tiŋmba kuke tugu pismba taŋanaig kande.
Ye siŋka satiŋgamŋgit. Ait suŋgo mbolŋge tale Korasin le Betsaida tumbraŋ tale Sidon le Tirus tuku pa limba tale suŋgo pasa ŋak tamŋgaik.

Kaperneum tumbraŋ ne nyu suŋgo ŋak minmba ne samba mbol kambim tuku ŋga iduste e? Kuateŋge ne tumba bukŋguwa le ne kumanu mbal tuku tumbraŋ kaŋgat. Ye wam kitek saŋgrinu tane ŋgamukŋge ke liken ta ande nu wam ndui ta Sodom tumbraŋ ŋgamukŋge ke likina kande nane ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba kile minig kande.
Ye tane satiŋgamŋgit. Ait suŋgo mbolŋge tane Kaperneum mbal Sodom tuku pa ta limba tane suŋgo pasa ŋak tamŋgaig.
Sine ka Yesus tugumŋge mabtube

Ait ta mbolŋge ndo Yesus nu sakina: O Mam, ne samba kilke tuku Suŋgo. Ye ne tuku nyu te-duŋget. Afu kila sugo wamdus kuyar ŋak ne naŋe wam kame tum ndaniŋgit. Kiŋo kame taŋaŋ minig mbal ne nane ndo tumniŋgit.
O Mam, ne naŋe nzali dubimba ne taŋate ŋgina.

Kile Yesus nu nane saniŋgina: Mam nu wam ŋakmba ye wai mbolŋge patikina. Ande nu Kuate tuku Kiŋo kila mine ndakate. Mam nu ndo ye kila. Ande nu Mam kila mine ndakate. Ye nu tuku Kiŋo ye ndo nu kila. Ye nane afu Mam kila pilwaig ŋga nu tumniŋget ta nane mata nu kila minig.
Tane piro kareŋka agaŋ pitinu kuramba poska minig mbal tane ye tugum te yalpe le yeŋge muskil kile-tidiŋge tiŋgi.
Ye wamdus bafuk ŋak minmba ŋgan mukuk minet tukunu tane ye tuku pasa kumnemŋge minap le tane tumtiŋgi le tane mabtap.
Ye tuku miŋge pasa ta piti kuga. Ye tane mbolŋge agaŋ pilet ta buloknu ndo ŋga saniŋgina.
